# Kix

> Kix is a Kubernetes compiler. Describe your whole stack in one definition; Kix compiles it into a verifiable cluster artifact, checks cross-resource invariants and policy before deploy, and rolls changes out in dependency order. Every `/docs/...` page is available as clean Markdown by sending `Accept: text/markdown` or appending `.md` to the URL path.

## Getting Started & Tutorials

- [Documentation Home](https://kix.run/docs/): Overview of the documentation sections and agent discovery endpoints
- [Tutorials Index](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/): Step-by-step path from your first local cluster to authoring packages and scorecards
- [01. Orientation](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/01-orientation/): What Kix is, why it exists, and the core mental model
- [02. Local Setup and First Run](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/02-local-setup-and-first-run/): Run an example cluster on local `kind`
- [03. Project Files and Flake Entry Point](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/03-project-skeleton-and-flake-shape/): Understand `flake.nix`, `mkFlake`, and cluster discovery
- [04. First Cluster from Scratch](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/04-first-cluster-from-scratch/): Write and deploy a minimal cluster definition
- [05. Basic Graph and Deploy Loop](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/05-basic-graph-and-deploy-loop/): The `kix check`, `build`, `diff`, `deploy`, and `graph` workflow
- [06. Local Package and Service Dependency](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/06-first-local-package-and-service-to-service-dependency/): Import a local package and wire a service-to-service dependency
- [07. Package Anatomy and Resource Composition](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/07-package-anatomy-and-safe-resource-composition/): How `{ scope, lib, kix }`, `meta`, `options`, `build`, and `out` fit together
- [08. Dependency Resolution and Namespace Boundaries](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/08-basic-dependency-resolution-and-namespace-boundaries/): Explicit cross-namespace wiring with `ref`
- [09. Typed Package Options](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/09-typed-package-options/): Declare and validate package options with `lib.mkOption`
- [10. Reusing Packages](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/10-reusing-packages/): Instantiate one package multiple times across instances and environments
- [11. Flavors, Roles, and Imports](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/11-flavors-roles-and-imports/): Connect to cluster flavors, infrastructure roles, and external services via `kix.mkImport`
- [12. Scorecards and Compile-Time Policy](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/12-scorecards-and-compile-time-policy/): Write and enforce custom scorecard rules

## Core Reference

- [Reference Overview & Cheat Sheet](https://kix.run/docs/reference/): Task routing table and top Nix DSL idioms
- [Cluster Configuration](https://kix.run/docs/reference/cluster-configuration/): Top-level `cluster.*` options, capabilities, topology, namespaces, `autoNamespace`, `availablePackages`, `networkPolicy`, and `scorecard`
- [Instances and Composition](https://kix.run/docs/reference/instances-and-composition/): `instances.<namespace>.<name>` schema (`package`, `config`, `deps`, `ref`, `aliases`, `optional`, `partsOverlays`), `kix.mkEnv`, and `kix.mergeFragments`
- [Flavors and Capabilities](https://kix.run/docs/reference/flavors-and-capabilities/): Built-in `kix.flavors.*` profiles, capability matrix, platform imports, and storage/DNS defaults
- [Package Anatomy](https://kix.run/docs/reference/package-anatomy/): Package function signature, `meta`, `options`, reusable option sets (`kix.options.*`), `build` entries, and package diagnostics
- [Resources and `out`](https://kix.run/docs/reference/resources-and-out/): `scope.mkResource`, workload builders (`mkDeployment`, `mkStatefulSet`, `mkDaemonSet`, `mkJob`), services, labels, `.out` attributes by kind, string-context dependency rules, and `kix.keep`
- [Composition Helpers (`kix.*`)](https://kix.run/docs/reference/composition-helpers/): Environment variables, volume mounts, `service.fromWorkload`, `expose`, `monitor`, `healthCheck`, `availability`, `image` & pins, and `untrackedRef`
- [Secrets, CRDs, and RBAC](https://kix.run/docs/reference/secrets-crds-and-rbac/): `scope.mkSecret`, `scope.mkSecretRef`, `scope.mkCRD`, `scope.mkCRDRef`, `kix.crd.*`, and `scope.rbac.*`
- [Helm and Imports](https://kix.run/docs/reference/helm-and-imports/): Wrapping Helm charts (`scope.helm.importChart`, `kix.helmChart`) and declaring external services (`kix.mkImport`)
- [Scorecard and Rules](https://kix.run/docs/reference/scorecard-and-rules/): Scorecard rule schema, finding schema, severity overrides, and built-in security, reliability, governance, and architecture rules
- [Validation Checks](https://kix.run/docs/reference/validation-checks/): Always-on cross-resource validation checks run during cluster evaluation
- [Annotations, CRDs, and Receipts](https://kix.run/docs/reference/annotations-crds-and-receipts/): `kix.run/*` annotation and label catalog, `Activation` and `PackageInstance` CRDs, and deploy receipt schema

## Architecture & Explanation

- [Explanation Index](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/): Conceptual guides to Kix's compiler model
- [The Dependency Graph as the Model](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/the-dependency-graph-as-the-model/): Store-path context edges, the dependency resolution ladder, and the DAG-driven deployment scheduler
- [Personas, Packages, and Clusters](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/personas-packages-and-clusters/): App maintainer vs platform vs operator boundaries, package vs instance, and Kix as a strict Kubernetes superset
- [Network Policy Derivation from the Graph](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/network-policy-derivation-from-the-graph/): How endpoint facts and service dependencies compile into default-deny policies
- [Helm Integration and Resource Adoption](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/helm-integration-and-resource-adoption/): Build-time chart evaluation, intra-chart DAG reconstruction, and `kix.mkImport` adoption
- [Availability Levels and Derived Pod Spread](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/availability-levels-and-derived-pod-spread/): How `cluster.availability` drives replica counts, topology spread, and PodDisruptionBudgets
- [Scorecard Levels and Validation](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/scorecard-levels-manifest-package-namespace-cluster/): Manifest, package, namespace, and cluster scorecard scopes vs compiler validation checks
- [Server-Side Apply, Field Ownership, and Drift](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/server-side-apply-field-ownership-and-drift/): Field ownership, ceding controller fields, `kix.run/applied-hash` drift detection, and why deploy inputs are committed
